speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin your evaluation for acute diarrhea, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and what do your stools look like?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) secondary to recent levofloxacin therapy. Given the high probability of antibiotic-associated diarrhea, I am requesting stool testing for C. difficile toxin.
